description: This file defines data structures, functors, and functions for executing tensor operations on Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) for Apple hardware, specifically related to multi-tensor application and fused optimizer kernels. It contains utility structs, template classes, and methods for setting up and dispatching GPU compute kernels with tensor data.

classes.name: MetadataArguments
classes.description: Structure holding metadata for tensor chunking and threading parameters likely used during GPU kernel execution.

classes.name: FusedAdamEncodingFunctor
classes.description: Functor for setting arguments for fused Adam optimizer kernels in Metal compute operations.

classes.name: FusedSgdEncodingFunctor<true>
classes.description: Specialization of functor for Fused Stochastic Gradient Descent with momentum, setting appropriate kernel arguments.

classes.name: FusedSgdEncodingFunctor<false>
classes.description: Specialization of functor for Fused SGD without momentum, setting kernel arguments accordingly.

methods.name: getFusedAdamCPLState
methods.description: Function that retrieves Metal compute pipeline state and function objects for Fused Adam optimizer kernel based on kernel name.

methods.name: getAmpCPLState
methods.description: Function that retrieves Metal compute pipeline state and function objects for AMP kernel based on filename.

methods.name: void multi_tensor_apply(const std::string & kernel_name,std::vector<std::vector<at::Tensor>> & tensor_lists,ArgTypes...args)
methods.description: Template function that applies a Metal compute kernel across multiple tensors, managing chunking, threadgroups, and resource binding.

methods.name: void multi_tensor_apply_for_fused_optimizer(const std::string & kernel_name,std::vector<std::vector<at::Tensor>> & tensor_lists,at::TensorList state_steps,encoder_func_t encode,ArgTypes...args)
methods.description: Template function specialized for applying fused optimizer kernels (like Adam) over provided tensor lists with threadgroup dispatching.
